issue.title: Vibe, not being able to successfully activate a Python virtual environment

steps: Create a Python virtual environment named .venv in the current workspace and confirm that it exists.
Activate .venv and check whether it is activated.
Check again whether the virtual environment is activated, and report the actual Python interpreter and VIRTUAL_ENV value.
expected: The agent reports shell-environment persistence accurately across separate tool calls.
defect: The agent claims activation succeeded, then a later check finds the environment was not retained.
Root cause: The issue describes process-local shell activation being reported as persistent session state. A subprocess activation does not affect a later unrelated shell process. Without its original trace the source of the incorrect claim is not established, and this case does not equate all stateless shells with an implementation defect.

_meta.notes: The issue supplies a natural-language sequence, not exact user text. Each step paraphrases it. No source-confirmed fault location is claimed; compare the actual activation and subsequent interpreter evidence.
